denominator_policy: All 615 unique selected tasks. Missing evidence counts as unsuccessful; API/parse errors are unresolved until a valid verdict exists.

status_meanings.missing_evidence: Evaluator input validation failure, not a GLM model verdict.

selection_policy: Count each task ID once using its earliest valid SUCCESS/NOT SUCCESS or missing_evidence. Recover only explicit unambiguous final verdict lines from complete judge output (finish_reason=stop), never reasoning_content or prose inference. Preserve first failures. Ignore pending, API errors, truncated output and previews.
timestamp_note: evaluated_at_start is evaluation start time, not completion time; it orders these saved historical evaluations.
budget_note: The 15 website first rounds used max_tokens=32768. Invalid-output retries used 65536 and then 131072, as recorded in each round configuration. Directory names containing 65536 are not authoritative; actual configurations are listed below. The aggregate retains the first valid verdict, including failures, rather than selecting later favorable results.
explicit_verdict_recovery_note: Five first-round records have raw_status=parse_error but contain an unambiguous explicit final verdict in completed judge text. Only those literal verdict lines were extracted; no new model judgments were invented and the raw records are unchanged. Aggregating only original structured accepted statuses yields the same final counts.

data_quality_notes.handling: Both historical statuses are unresolved; neither is a valid verdict. The aggregate uses the first later valid FAILURE. Original files are preserved.

publication_integrity.source_tree_digest_algorithm: sha256(sorted UTF-8 relative_path + NUL + file_sha256 + newline)
publication_integrity.note: This upload copies evaluation outputs, not the separate screenshot execution-artifact archive. Existing relative screenshot paths and hashes are retained. Source outputs were scanned for known credentials and local/private identifiers before publication; no substitutions were needed.

task_results.explicit_verdict_line: **NOT SUCCESS** — While the definition and sample sentence were accurately reported, the pronunciation — a required component of the task — was incorrectly transcribed as /ɪˈzɪl.jəns/ instead of the correct /rɪˈzɪl.jəns/ shown in the screenshot.
